svg.title: Canton provisional modern-context north-south terrain profile
svg.desc: A center-column R16 profile from south to north, derived from modern EGM2008 context. It is D-confidence and does not represent accepted late-Qing elevations.
svg.text: Center column, x = 2016 m local · modern EGM2008 context · D-confidence
Historical walking surface and vertical datum remain blocked; this is not an 1880–1900 terrain profile.
